name: Bourke
source: Bureau of Meteorology, Water Data Online (KiWIS API)
datum: m above the local gauge zero (local gauge height; zero elevation not given by the API)
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), per BoM Water Data Online copyright notice. Credit: Bureau of Meteorology, Water Data Online, with data supplied by the station owner (see notes).
notes: BoM series DMQaQc.Merged.DailyMean.24HR, ts_id 169534010, station_id 590760 (station 425003 DARLING@BOURKE TOWN). Data owner: NSW - Water NSW.

Daily mean of the merged quality-controlled level record, aggregated by BoM to a 24-hour mean. The API does not say how many readings fed each early-year mean; where only one staff reading a day was taken, the 'mean' is that one reading.

Quality codes ({10: 'quality-A best available Quality', 90: 'quality-B compromised', 110: 'quality-C estimate', 140: 'quality-E unknown'}): counts {10: 10036, 90: 4007, 110: 144, 140: 5764}. Mapping: A (10) and B (90, compromised) -> measured; C (110, estimate) -> estimated; E (140, unknown quality) -> measured before 1991 and provisional from 1991 on (195 days), where it marks recent unchecked readings.
28156 empty timestamps (code -1) and 0 values coded F (210, missing or incorrect) were dropped.

measurement_history.fact: The series starts 1895-02-01 with daily 08:00 readings for that year, all quality B (compromised).
Record resumes with several readings a day; quality E (unknown) until 1988.
The Bourke lock and weir, about 7 km from town, was built in 1897 and rebuilt as a concrete weir in 1941. Whether the town gauge sits in the weir pool is not stated.
Not found: why 1896-1972 is missing, gauge moves and datum history.

public_notes: The usable record at Bourke starts in mid-1972; there is one year from 1895 and then nothing for 76 years. Quality is rated unknown until 1988.
